 Component testing machine inspekt vario
In component testing, complete components or individual parts of a product are tested according to defined standards and specifications. The testing of components includes their application safety, strength, formability, toughness and fatigue properties.
Hegewald & Peschke has developed the inspekt vario testing machine series especially for testing components of different sizes and shapes. Based on the proven technology of the inspekt testing machines, the inspekt vario is characterised above all by its flexibility. The testing machines have 2 backlash-free ball screws and 4 surface-hardened guide columns. The columns are intentionally not covered to guarantee a high degree of flexibility. This significantly improves accessibility for operating personnel and for supplementary testing and sensor technology.
 Features and advantages
Open Design
The open enables a high flexibility in terms of testing machine dimensions: test room depth and height can be adapted specifically to the component. The usable test room space is increased as there are no panelling limitations. In addition, the columns can be used for mounting accessories.
Various load levels and test room widths 
8 load levels as standard: 100 kN, 250 kN, 400 kN, 600 kN, 1200 kN, 1500 kN, 2000 kN, 2500 kN. 
test room widths are variable and can be selected: 610 mm, 750 mm, 1000 mm  
Due to the modular design principle of the inspekt vario testing machine series, individual customer requirements can also be implemented in addition to series production.
Solid construction for highest measuring and control precision 
4 guiding columns and 2 backlash-free precision ball screws:
 → Precise force transmission
 → High lateral force stability
 → Increased axial stiffness 
Robust design with bellow cover
 → Low maintenance needs
 → Also for use in harsh production environments 
Innovative control electronics for maximum measurement resolution & extensive functionality 
High modularity and control precision 
Adaptive controller 
High-quality signal converters for maximum resolution 
Standard functions:
 → Force, displacement, strain control
 → Overload protection
 → Automatic sensor identification incl. calibration data storage
 → Specimen break detection
 → Return function
 → Manual positioning via hand panel or our testing software LabMaster 
Highest safety with maximum operating convenience 
CE-compliant protective housing optionally available for every application 
Sustainable: capable for cost-efficient and application-oriented updates/upgrades

 Our testing machines speak your language: LabMaster - the testing software by Hegewald und Peschke
The inspekt vario testing machine series is equipped with the LabMaster testing software, which enables user-friendly setup and execution of test sequences for customised tests. It includes all test modules (tensile, compression, bending and peel tests) at no extra cost, enabling both simple and complex test sequences to be carried out in compliance with standards. LabMaster guarantees fast and reliable determination of results and offers a high degree of flexibility when integrating external measuring devices. Data import and export for customised software such as QDAS or SAP is also possible.

 Testing technology for component testing and furniture testing
Component and furniture testing has been a core area of expertise at Hegewald & Peschke for over 30 years. During this time, we have established ourselves as a reliable partner for industry, research, and development—with testing systems that combine precision, flexibility, and durability.
Our component testing systems and test benches enable the reliable assessment of the mechanical properties and service life of a wide variety of components – from furniture to vehicle and machine components to complex technical assemblies. We cover a broad spectrum: 
static, dynamic, and cyclic load tests 
single-axis and multi-axis applications 
individually adaptable to your requirements. Thanks to state-of-the-art sensor technology and software integration, all testing processes can be customized, fully automated, documented, and evaluated.
Our testing systems are precision products that meet industry standards. Thanks to established control and regulation circuits, we guarantee maximum accuracy, stability, and repeatability of measurement results. Our extensive standard portfolio can also be adapted to customer-specific testing tasks in a modular fashion – from individual test benches to complex, multi-axis test fields.
The universal testing machines of the inspekt vario series can be used in a wide load range up to 2500 kN and impress with their open design and variable test space sizes, making them ideal for a wide variety of component geometries and sizes.
The calmar test rig series offers flexible solutions for static, dynamic, and multi-axis component testing: Individual test stands with a focus on a specific application as well as modular test fields with freely positionable electric or pneumatic test axes that can be individually configured and synchronized are available with various control concepts. This means that calmar component testing solutions are not only flexible, but can also be configured and easily operated for use in research laboratories or for everyday quality control.
 Universal test benches of the Calmar series and component testing machine inspekt vario
Modular system – service-friendly and future-proof
The modular architecture of our Calmar and inspekt systems not only enables flexible test setups, but also high service availability and sustainable spare parts supply. Our customers benefit from a long-term secure investment that can be expanded or modernized at any time. Thanks to our experience, we also offer the modernization of existing test fields and test machines – regardless of the manufacturer. This ensures that existing systems remain technically up to date and economically efficient.
Everything from a single source – our expertise is your testing solution
Consulting, design, software development, production, calibration, service, and maintenance. This concept allows us to work in a customer-oriented manner and to establish testing solutions that precisely meet your requirements. We program our testing software ourselves, which means we can implement customer requests and adjustments directly at any time. We look forward to this challenge and your inquiry!
 Precision at the highest level
As a DAkkS-accredited testing laboratory for material and component testing machines, we have extensive expertise in the calibration of the physical quantities force, displacement, and hardness. Our calibration laboratory checks the entire measurement chain to ensure that not only the sensor but also the measurement data in the test sequence meet the necessary quality standards. Special calibration tools have been developed for this purpose, which allow the force transducers and displacement measurement systems to be checked while installed!
For demanding applications, a wide range of specialized and application-specific measurement technology is also available, for example: 
Integratable temperature sensors 
External data acquisition systems for clock-synchronous integration of external measurement channels 
Video measurement technology for deformation measurement and image evaluation using digital image correlation (DIC) for spatially resolved strain analysis for the creation of 2D deformation maps 
3D system for optical deformation measurement in the X, Y, and Z axes for component testing in test fields and universal testing machines.

What are the advantages of component testing by Hegewald & Peschke?
Furniture and components must withstand a wide variety of stresses in daily use. In order to meet the high requirements for safety, quality, and operational stability, it makes sense to test both the individual components and the finished product.
Hegewald & Peschke's portfolio offers the perfect testing systems to meet these quality requirements: 
During the development phase: with comprehensive hardware and software solutions that allow maximum freedom in the individual design of the test configuration and test sequences. 
In day-to-day quality assurance: with the creation of test templates, a simple user interface, and the option of user management. 
The product and component testing systems allow you to cleanly implement a variety of national and international standards and certifications. Test templates that are prepared and can be customized individually help with this. Our team is available to advise you on both the hardware design and the software implementation of the testing system.
Thorough testing contributes significantly to ensuring product quality and helps to accelerate development times considerably. Test solutions from Hegewald & Peschke thus offer a competitive advantage and are also a flagship for your quality awareness.
What component testing methods are available?
Virtually every component changes over the course of its use due to thermal, mechanical, or other stresses. The task of development is to design products or components in such a way that they fulfill their function throughout their entire life cycle. To this end, service life estimates must be carried out in accordance with stress profiles. Various computational and experimental component testing methods are used for this purpose. 
Non-destructive testing methods: Checking a component for defects, e.g., cracks, without damaging it. 
Destructive static testing methods: Analysis of the mechanical properties and fracture behavior of components. 
Opterational strength tests: These tests examine the ability of components to withstand cyclical recurring loads over their planned service life without damage. Fatigue strength is usually verified by a combination of experimental and theoretical calculations. The findings are necessary for the design of components and products. 
Fatigue strength tests: In contrast to operational strength, the resistance of a material to cyclical alternating loads is examined. The aim of this load test is to investigate how long a material or component can withstand oscillating loads without failing. The result is a graph showing the number of load cycles that can be withstood as a function of the stress amplitude (Wöhler curve).

 Testing applications » 
 Automotive 
 Component testing in the automotive industry
 Test benches and universal testing machines for vehicle components
In the automotive industry, components and assemblies must meet the highest standards of safety, durability, and functionality. Hegewald & Peschke develops and supplies testing systems for component testing in the automotive sector that simulate real-life load scenarios and deliver reproducible results. Our automotive test benches are used in development, series production support, and quality assurance, enabling realistic stress, functional, and service life tests on vehicle components, from individual parts to assemblies.
 Seats
Numerous mechanical tests are performed on vehicle seats to verify their safety, load-bearing capacity, and fatigue strength. Relevant testing standards require cyclic load tests in two load directions. The standardized vehicle seat test stands from Hegewald & Peschke are equipped with a force- and displacement-controlled electromechanical test axis and can apply test forces of up to 5,000 N with a maximum stroke of 200 mm. They are particularly well-suited for endurance tests, in which both the damage pattern after the test is completed and the progression of damage throughout the entire test can be analyzed.
Seat testing
 Brakes
The demands placed on brake pads are constantly increasing. Heavier vehicles and more powerful drivetrains require ever-greater braking performance and, consequently, particularly durable components. To test shear strength, brake pads are tested in universal testing machines, such as the inspekt table 250 kN, using a special shear device. In this process, the brake pad is secured in a specially developed fixture, and the adhesive bond between the backing plate and the friction lining is subjected to a defined shear force. Depending on the test specification, the load is applied laterally or from above and is continuously recorded until the adhesive bond fails.
Testing of brake pads
 Batteries and Fuel Cells
Battery cells are at the heart of electric vehicles and are subjected to a wide range of electrochemical, thermal, and mechanical stresses during operation. For testing these cells, Hegewald & Peschke offers a specially tailored testing system consisting of a universal testing machine (inspekt 100 kN) and a temperature-controlled chamber for simulating real-world environmental conditions. The system is used to perform compression tests to simulate the mechanical stresses on battery cells, such as those caused by temperature changes or the installation conditions within the vehicle.
Testing of battery cells
Fuel cells enable efficient and emission-free energy generation by directly converting hydrogen and oxygen into electrical energy and water. As a result, they are becoming increasingly important, particularly as a propulsion technology for vehicles. Test machines from the inspekt series by Hegewald & Peschke are used for quality assurance in the manufacturing process. In this process, several fuel cells are pressed together to form a so-called stack, on which mechanical pressure tests with test forces of up to 100 kN are performed. These tests ensure the required stability and functional safety of the fuel cell stacks.
Testing of fuel cells
 Shift simulation
High mechanical stresses on vehicle shifting systems are simulated through endurance and cyclic tests to detect wear and potential failures at an early stage. The cable-shift test stand from Hegewald & Peschke enables vertical and horizontal testing of cable-shift systems for manual transmissions under real-world conditions. Using the LabMaster test software, all relevant test parameters—including force, displacement, speed, cycle count, and pause time—can be freely programmed and precisely controlled. This allows a wide variety of load scenarios to be simulated in a manner that complies with standards and is reproducible.
Testing of shifting systems and shift levers
 Belts
Testing the ultimate tensile load of seat belt systems—consisting of a seat belt, belt pretensioner, and buckle—is an essential component of vehicle safety. Only through tests conducted in accordance with standards, such as ECE R16, can it be ensured that the individual components will function reliably in an emergency. For these testing tasks, Hegewald & Peschke offers high-performance universal testing machines with a rated force of up to 100 kN. The specially designed testing system for seat belt systems features a test room extended by 500 mm as well as additional front and rear safety doors. An integrated impact shield catches falling metal parts and increases safety for the machine and testing personnel during the test.
Seat belt testing
 Rubber and Plastic Automotive Parts
Mechanical testing of rubber and plastic components is typically performed using a tensile test in accordance with the relevant ISO 37 and DIN EN ISO 527 standards. With its tensile testing machines from the inspekt duo, inspekt blue, and inspekt table series, Hegewald & Peschke offers a versatile portfolio to meet a wide range of testing requirements. Depending on the required test force and component size, the appropriate testing system can be selected to perform standards-compliant and reproducible material tests.
Testing of rubber/elastomers
Testing of plastics
 Vehicle Body - Testing of Thin Steel or Aluminum Sheets
High-strength thin steel and aluminum sheets are used in the manufacture of modern vehicle bodies, and their forming properties are critical to component quality. In the metal tensile test per DIN EN ISO 6892, the vertical anisotropy (r value) is determined in accordance with DIN EN ISO 10113, which provides important insights into the deep-drawing behavior and formability of the sheets. With universal testing machines from the inspekt table series and suitable strain measurement systems, Hegewald & Peschke offers a high-performance solution for determining the r value in accordance with standards, thereby supporting material characterization, quality control, and the approval of new material batches.
Testing of thin sheets
 Transmissions - Inspection of fine-blanked parts
High-precision fine-blanking parts are used in vehicle transmissions; these parts are characterized by right-angled, virtually burr-free cut surfaces and high dimensional accuracy. Since these components are subjected to high mechanical stresses during operation, they must meet strict quality requirements both during development and in series production. For quality assurance, the components are tested using the universal testing machine inspekt blue 20 kN nd a specially adapted loading device. The goal of the testing is to verify mechanical strength and ensure component functionality while keeping the component weight as low as possible.
Testing of fine-blanking parts
Your advantages with test benches from Hegewald and Peschke 
Modular component test benches: Adaptable to component geometry and test task 
Single-axis and multi-axis test benches: With servo-electric and/or pneumatic test axes 
High control and measurement accuracy: Reproducible results even in dynamic tests 
Flexible test software: Freely definable test sequences without programming knowledge – everything from standard-compliant tests to customer-specific test sequences can be implemented 
Future-proof: Modular design offers expansion for new components and standards 
We specialize in automotive testing technology and, in addition to our universal testing machines and component test benches, we also offer special test benches such as torsion testing machines and stone impact testers. For our vehicle testing technology, we provide you with excellent service and software support, as well as a supply of spare and wear parts for 10 years.

Are you planning to test components in the automotive sector and looking for a suitable test bench or universal testing machine? With our many years of experience in the automotive sector, we are happy to support you in designing the optimal testing system.

The standard ensures that the mechanical properties of the two materials are tested under standardised conditions so that the results are comparable. The results ensure that products made from these materials meet the required specifications and quality standards.

The ISO 10113 test is intended for flat metal products such as thin sheets or strips—for example, made of steel or aluminum—for which anisotropic strain properties are critical. Typical fields of application include the automotive and automotive supply industries, mechanical engineering, and other sectors where sheet metal forming plays a role. Thin sheets are used in all branches of industry, which is why extensive material testing is required. The result (r-value) is used to optimize forming processes and for the acceptance testing of new material batches.

The inspekt blue 20 kN universal testing machine with a pressure device is used for quality assurance.

Hegewald & Peschke offers specialized universal testing machines from the inspekt table series, which enable both standardized and individual testing procedures.

 Universal Testing Machine inspekt 250kN with Temperature Chamber and Video Extensometer
Industries: Automotive industry, aviation and aerospace industry, plastics industry 
Carbon fiber reinforced plastics (CFRP), commonly known as carbon, are characterized by their high strength combined with low weight. These properties make them ideal for applications in aerospace, automotive, and sports equipment industries. The testing system is used to determine the mechanical properties of composite samples by means of tensile tests (e.g. according to ASTM D3039 & DIN EN ISO 527) and bending tests (e.g. according to ASTM D790 & DIN EN ISO 14125.

 Insulators & electrical components 
 Testing technology for insulators and electrotechnical components
Insulators and electrical connecting elements play a central role in energy and electrical engineering: they ensure the safe separation of live components, prevent leakage currents, secure cable routes, and protect against environmental influences. To ensure that these components function reliably throughout their entire life cycle – whether in high-voltage grids, electromobility, or sensitive electronic assemblies – standard-compliant, robust, and high-precision testing systems are essential.
Hegewald & Peschke offers a wide range of universal testing machines with different load ranges for this purpose. They cover tensile, compression, shear, and bending tests as well as endurance and fatigue tests. Thanks to a wide range of accessories and flexible expansion options, the systems can be optimally adapted to your individual testing tasks—from fine strands and cable lugs (20 kN) to high-voltage insulators and battery components (up to 600 kN).
An excerpt from our testing applications: 
Tensile and flex tests on cables, membranes, and seals 
Shear force tests on contacts and solder joints 
Pressure and creep tests on pipes and connecting elements 
High-load tests on high-voltage insulators 
Testing of contact elements, cables, and strands 
Testing on pipe insulation and cable clamps 
Battery tests for applications in energy and electromobility 
Whether you are testing prototypes or series components, our testing systems for insulators and electrotechnical components ensure reliable, reproducible results in accordance with all relevant standards, thereby making a decisive contribution to the quality and safety of your products.
